title: Manifold Approximation leads to Robust Kernel Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2510.22953v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Centered kernel alignment (CKA) is a popular metric for comparing representations, determining equivalence of networks, and conducting neuroscience research. However, CKA does not account for the underlying manifold and relies on numerous heuristics that cause it to behave differently at different scales of data. In this work, we propose Manifold-approximated Kernel Alignment (MKA), which incorporates manifold geometry (i.e., local neighborhood) into the alignment task. We derive a theoretical framework for MKA. Our construction removes representation-dependent degree weighting, yields a closed-form alignment score, and gives each row a probabilistic interpretation as a local Markov transition distribution. We further establish kernel- and score-level stability with respect to the neighborhood size. translated_title: 流形近似带来鲁棒的核对齐
translated_abstract: 中心化核对齐（CKA）是比较表示、判断网络等价性以及开展神经科学研究的一种常用度量。然而，CKA 没有考虑底层的流形结构，并且依赖众多启发式方法，导致其在不同数据规模下表现不一致。在本工作中，我们提出了流形近似核对齐（MKA），将流形几何（即局部邻域）融入到对齐任务中。我们为 MKA 推导了一个理论框架。我们的构造去除了依赖于表示的度加权，得到了闭式的对齐分数，并将每一行赋予了作为局部马尔可夫转移分布的概率解释。我们进一步建立了关于邻域大小的核级别与分数级别的稳定性。我们在合成数据集和真实世界示例上进行了实证评估，以刻画 MKA 并将其与同类方法进行比较。
tldr: 提出流形近似核对齐（MKA），通过将流形局部邻域几何融入核对齐任务，去除启发式度加权、给出闭式对齐分数及马尔可夫概率解释，并证明其对邻域大小的稳定性，从而实现更鲁棒的表示比较。
en_tdlr: We propose Manifold-approximated Kernel Alignment (MKA), which incorporates manifold (local neighborhood) geometry into kernel alignment, removing representation-dependent heuristic weighting and yielding a closed-form, probabilistically interpretable score that is stable to neighborhood size for robust representation comparison.
